name: Le Carnet Bleu
description: A setting-aware live murder mystery with one host role and five assignable suspect roles.

authoring.instructions: Collect and validate the real setting before drafting characters, clues, physical staging, or the canonical solution. Give every setting resource a stable ID; crosslink setup, opening execution, clue provenance, and solution support with those IDs. Never assume the demo house is the venue.

settingQuestions.prompt: What is the real venue called, and what kind of place is it?
Where is the venue, and which local details should the story use?
Should the fiction be present-day, historical, timeless, or another specific era?
Which rooms or outdoor areas may be used during play?
How can players safely move between those spaces, and which routes are off-limits?
Which real features could become clues or story elements?
Which costumes and safe props already exist or can easily be prepared?
What tone should the evening have?
What physical, privacy, timing, or venue rules must never be crossed?
Does anyone need seated play, step-free routes, larger text, lower sensory load, or another accommodation?
Which themes, relationships, or kinds of harm should the story avoid?

commands.name: replace_enrolment
commands.description: Replace the editable host, seats and venue proof.

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Lock the role labels and expose the dossier links.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start play when the host is ready.

commands.name: complete_opening_step
commands.description: Complete the next authored opening step.

commands.name: advance_act
commands.description: Finish the single authored cold open and release the room into continuous investigation.

commands.name: buy_clue
commands.description: Spend the current clue price for one private random clue from a chosen deck.

commands.name: transfer_tokens
commands.description: Move tradable tokens between two suspect roles.

commands.name: enable_duplicate_clues
commands.description: Allow exhausted decks to issue duplicate clues for pacing.

commands.name: call_accusation
commands.description: Start a public accusation hearing with an accuser, accused suspect, and stated case.

commands.name: advance_hearing
commands.description: Advance the hearing through case, defense, statements, and voting.

commands.name: cast_vote
commands.description: Record one suspect's public conviction vote.

commands.name: end_investigation
commands.description: End investigation when the time limit expires and begin the reveal.

commands.name: set_objective_completed
commands.description: Record whether one scored character objective was completed.

commands.name: record_award
commands.description: Record the table-voted performance or costume award.
